property_summary: The `controller()` view function must return the address stored in the contract's storage slot; the bug replaces this with a hardcoded constant, so any call to `controller()` will return 0xDeaDbeefdEAdbeefdEadbEEFdeadbeEFdEaDbeeF instead of the actual controller address.
change_summary: Replace the storage read with an arbitrary constant address (0xdead...beef).
mutated_unit_code: function controller() public view returns (IController) { return IController(address(0xDeaDbeefdEAdbeefdEadbEEFdeadbeEFdEaDbeeF)); }
